title: Compute brief - 12 November 2026
description: Nvidia lost its founder-CEO. Jensen Huang resigned with immediate effect and CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO, five days before fiscal Q3 results, while Nebius beat on revenue but pushed some third-party capacity into 2027 and lifted 2026 capex to about $27 billion. Wire: Nvidia CEO transition, Nebius Q3, Andhra Pradesh 1 GW and 2 GW pledges, AWS Chile region, Saudi Infra-HUMAIN financing, SoftBank $3.7 billion power-gear loss, Boise moratorium. Tape: 70 confirms, 0 ticks, 0 NEW.
og_kicker: The chips have no CEO. The capacity has no date.
lede: Nvidia said Thursday that Jensen Huang has resigned as president, CEO and director, effective immediately, after 33 years; its 8-K says the board accepted the resignation on 11 November. CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO and stays CFO, Harvey Jones becomes the first board chair, and fiscal Q3 results stay on 17 November. Nvidia gave no reason; the exit follows the board's 8 November review of reports that Huang was targeted by a foreign intelligence effort. Shares fell about 10% to 12%. Nvidia is also the GPU market's largest financier, with about $36 billion of cloud-service commitments plus stakes in and credit support for neoclouds and labs (TechCrunch), so neocloud stocks fell with it. Nebius beat on Q3 revenue at $980.8 million but cut 2026 guidance to $3.0 to $3.2 billion because some third-party capacity slipped into 2027, raised 2026 capex to about $27 billion and guided $40 to $45 billion for 2027, 75% to 85% funded by prepayments and asset-backed debt. Live list prices held for a fourth straight day: 70 confirms, 0 ticks and 0 NEW, with Lambda H100 at $4.59 and B200 at $7.69.
